q: If $\vec A=2\hat i+3\hat j-\hat k$ and $\vec B=\hat i-2\hat j+2\hat k$, find $\vec A\cdot\vec B$ and the component of $\vec A$ along $\vec B$.
A projectile is fired at $20\ \text{m/s}$ at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal ($g=10$). Find maximum height, time of flight and range.
A $5$ kg block slides from rest down a frictionless $30^\circ$ incline. Find its acceleration and the time to cover $10$ m ($g=10$).
A $20$ g bullet moving at $300$ m/s embeds in a $2$ kg suspended block. Find the common velocity and the height risen ($g=10$).
A motor lifts $500$ kg from a $20$ m deep well in $50$ s. Find its output power, and the input power if efficiency is $80\%$ ($g=10$).
A $1000$ kg car at $72$ km/h is braked to rest in $40$ m. Find the initial KE, the average retarding force and the deceleration.
Find $g$ at a height equal to Earth's radius $R$ above the surface ($g_0=9.8$), and the escape velocity if $v_{orbit}=7.92$ km/s near the surface.
A planet's orbital radius is $4$ times Earth's. Using Kepler's third law, find its period in years.
A wire of length $2$ m and cross-section $1\ \text{mm}^2$ extends by $1$ mm under a $20$ kg load ($g=10$). Find Young's modulus and the stored energy.
A soap bubble of radius $2$ cm has $T=0.025$ N/m. Find the excess pressure inside and the work done in blowing it.
A pipe narrows from $20\ \text{cm}^2$ to $5\ \text{cm}^2$. Water enters at $2$ m/s. Find the speed in the narrow part and the pressure drop ($\rho=1000$).
A particle in SHM has amplitude $5$ cm and period $2$ s. Find $v_{max}$, $a_{max}$ and speed at $x=3$ cm.
Find the length of a seconds pendulum ($g=9.8$). By what percent does $T$ change if the length rises by $21\%$?
A wave is $y=0.02\sin(4\pi x-200\pi t)$ (SI). Find wavelength, frequency and speed.
A closed pipe is $0.5$ m long ($v=340$ m/s). Find its fundamental and next resonant frequency. Forks of $256$ and $260$ Hz sound together: beat frequency?
sol: $f_1=\frac{v}{4L}=170$ Hz; next $=3f_1=510$ Hz; beats $=260-256=4$ per second.

q: Find the rms speed of O$_2$ ($M=0.032$ kg/mol) at $27^\circ$C ($R=8.31$). To what temperature must it be heated to double $v_{rms}$?
For $\vec A=3\hat i+4\hat j$ and $\vec B=4\hat i-3\hat j$, show that they are perpendicular and find the area of the parallelogram they span.
sol: $\vec A\cdot\vec B=12-12=0\Rightarrow$ perpendicular; $\vec A\times\vec B=(-9-16)\hat k=-25\hat k$; area $=25$ square units.

q: A boat ($5$ m/s in still water) crosses a $100$ m river flowing at $3$ m/s. Find the minimum crossing time with its drift, and the time for the shortest path.
sol: Minimum time: $t=100/5=20$ s, drift $=3\times20=60$ m. Shortest path: effective speed $=\sqrt{25-9}=4$ m/s, $t=25$ s.

q: In an Atwood machine $m_1=3$ kg, $m_2=5$ kg ($g=10$). Find the acceleration and tension.
A $2$ kg body at $6$ m/s collides elastically head-on with a stationary $4$ kg body. Find both final velocities and verify energy conservation.
sol: $v_1=\frac{2-4}{6}\times6=-2$ m/s; $v_2=\frac{2\times2}{6}\times6=4$ m/s. KE before $=36$ J; after $=4+32=36$ J ✓.

q: A car rounds a level curve of radius $50$ m with $\mu=0.5$ ($g=10$). Find its max speed, and the ideal banking angle for $20$ m/s on a frictionless banked road.
A force $F=(3x^2+2)$ N acts along $x$. Find the work done from $x=0$ to $x=3$ m.
A $0.5$ kg ball falls from $20$ m and rebounds to $5$ m ($g=10$). Find impact speed and energy lost.
Find $g$ at depth $R/2$ below the surface in terms of $g$, and the mass of Earth ($g=9.8$, $R=6.4\times10^6$ m, $G=6.67\times10^{-11}$).
A $200$ kg satellite orbits at radius $2R$. Find its total energy ($g=9.8$, $R=6.4\times10^6$ m).
Water ($T=0.072$ N/m, $\theta=0$) rises in a $0.5$ mm radius tube. Find the height ($g=9.8$, $\rho=1000$).
Find the terminal velocity of a sphere ($r=1$ mm, $\rho=2500$) in a liquid ($\sigma=1000$, $\eta=0.8$ Pa·s), $g=9.8$.
A tank has a hole $3.2$ m below the water surface and $1.8$ m above the ground ($g=10$). Find the efflux speed and horizontal range.
A $0.5$ kg mass on a spring ($k=200$ N/m) has amplitude $0.1$ m. Find $T$, total energy and KE at $x=0.05$ m.
An ambulance ($20$ m/s) emits $500$ Hz; sound speed $340$ m/s. Find the frequency heard by a stationary observer as it approaches and recedes.
A string $0.8$ m long, fixed at both ends, carries waves at $320$ m/s. Find the fundamental and third harmonic. If $T=64$ N, find its linear density.
Two moles of ideal gas at $300$ K occupy $10$ L. Find pressure, the pressure after isothermal compression to $5$ L, and mean KE per molecule ($R=8.31$, $k=1.38\times10^{-23}$).
